stories.name: Vassal Soul
stories.intro: A ghostly clerk in Azorius robes glides out of an archive. Death did not end its service. It finds you in breach of an old statute and swoops to enforce it.
stories.win: The spirit bows and swears its service to you. The law allows it.
stories.lose: It rakes you with cold hands and returns to its archive.
stories.flee: You run past the archive door, and it does not pursue.

stories.name: Lyev Skyknight
stories.intro: A skyknight on a winged mount lands across your path. Her lance glows, and your pack freezes on your back. "Stand for inspection."
stories.win: She lowers her lance and salutes. She will ride with you now.
stories.lose: She pins you with light and writes you a fine.
stories.flee: You break the hold and hide in an alley until she flies on.

stories.name: Detention Sphere
stories.title: A sphere holds a prisoner
stories.text: A glowing sphere hangs in the middle of a square, humming. Inside it, a man floats, frozen in place. An Azorius clerk is searching the cobbles for a lost writ of detention. Without it, she cannot hold him for long.

outcome.text: You and the clerk sweep the square.

huge_success.text: You find the writ under a cart. She trusts you to carry it to New Prahv and gives you the sphere's key.

success.text: You find the writ. She asks you to carry it to New Prahv and gives you the key.

failure.text: You search until dark and find no sign of it. The clerk sends you off.

outcome.text: She hands you the writ with relief. "New Prahv will want to hear this."

choices.text: Leave the man to the law

outcome.text: You move on, and the sphere hums on.

stories.name: Azorius Keyrune
stories.title: A keyrune of the Senate
stories.text: A small carved key lies on a Senate step, shaped like a bird. As you pick it up, it stretches its wings and tries to fly. A clerk runs toward you, shouting that it is Senate property.

outcome.text: The clerk thanks you and says to keep it. You have shown more care for the law than its owner.
The clerk calls the guard.
The keyrune settles back into stone.

stories.name: Azorius Guildgate
stories.text: A great white gate marks the road to the Senate, its arches carved with law. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.

stories.name: Archon of the Triumvirate
stories.intro: An archon descends over New Prahv on a winged steed, its face a mask of law. Wherever its shadow falls, things stop moving. Its shadow falls on you.
stories.win: The archon judges you worthy and offers its service. It is yours now.
stories.lose: The archon's judgement pins you to the ground until it has gone.
stories.flee: You stay out of its shadow and slip away.

stories.name: Azorius Charm
stories.title: A charm of logic
stories.text: An Azorius lawmage sells charms stamped with a seal of three choices. The rules of logic have already made the choice for you, she says. You still have to pay.

outcome.text: She hands you one and tells you which choice to make.

choices.text: Argue that the choice is yours

outcome.text: She raises an eyebrow.

success.text: She concedes the point and gives you a charm to prove it.

failure.text: She fines you for wasting the court's time.

outcome.text: You leave her to her ledger.

stories.name: Dramatic Rescue
stories.title: A roc from the sky
stories.text: An Azorius hussar is surrounded by Gruul raiders, and then a roc's shadow falls over them. Two tons of beak and claw drop from the sky and pluck her out. She has never been so glad of a bird.

choices.text: Signal the next roc for her squadmate

outcome.text: The roc swoops, and the hussar gives you the whistle that calls it.
You run in under the clubs.

huge_success.text: You both get clear, and the hussar gives you her whistle.

success.text: You drag him clear and keep the whistle he drops.

failure.text: A club catches you on the way out.

huge_failure.text: You are knocked flat, and the roc saves you too.

outcome.text: You watch the roc climb away.

stories.name: Fall of the Gavel
stories.title: The ruling is final
stories.text: A judge brings down her gavel, and the spell a defendant was casting falls apart in mid-air. The ruling is final, she says. Order is upheld.

outcome.text: She lets you copy one, and it carries the spell.
You reach for the pieces under the bench.

huge_success.text: The pieces fit back together in your hands, and the judge lets you keep them.

success.text: You keep the gavel's echo in a shard.

failure.text: The bailiff fines you for contempt.

outcome.text: You leave as the next case is called.

stories.name: Hussar Patrol
stories.intro: A patrol of Azorius hussars rounds the corner at a trot. You think no one is watching, their captain says. She has been watching you for three streets.
stories.win: The captain decides you are on the side of order and lends you her patrol. They are yours now.
stories.lose: They ride you down and leave you with a citation and a bruise.
stories.flee: You show your empty hands and back away.

stories.name: Isperia, Supreme Judge
stories.intro: Isperia sits in judgement at the top of New Prahv, her wings folded like a robe. She serves only justice, she says, and through it all of Ravnica. She would like to judge you.
stories.win: Isperia rules in your favour and agrees to serve you. Her card is yours.
stories.lose: Her ruling throws you down the stairs of the Senate.
stories.flee: You bow and back away from the bench.

stories.name: New Prahv Guildmage
stories.intro: A guildmage of New Prahv stands at the foot of the Senate steps, reciting statutes. He has decided you are in breach of several. He raises a hand, and the air stiffens around you.
stories.win: The guildmage finds a clause in your favour and joins you. He is yours now.
stories.lose: You are held fast until the bells, and fined for the delay.
stories.flee: You plead for a recess and leave.

stories.name: Righteous Authority
stories.title: The weight of authority
stories.text: An Azorius magistrate wears a mantle that grows heavier with every law she remembers. The heavier it is, the stronger she stands. She offers to share its weight.

outcome.text: Its weight settles on you, and you stand taller for it.
You recite them well, and she grants you the mantle.
You leave her to her laws.

stories.name: Search Warrant
stories.title: A satchel that glows
stories.text: An Azorius arrester stops a man whose satchel is glowing with unstable energy. Would you care to explain, she asks. He would not.

outcome.text: She finds the contraband and gives you the warrant to keep.
She looks from you to him.

success.text: She lets him go, and he slips you the warrant he stole.

huge_failure.text: The satchel explodes while she searches you both.

outcome.text: You leave the arrester to her questions.

stories.name: Skymark Roc
stories.intro: A roc swoops low over the street market, looking for thieves. Try not to look guilty, an urchin tells you, or delicious. It is too late for both.
stories.win: The roc lands, folds its wings, and lets you ride. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It snatches you up and drops you in a fountain.
stories.flee: You duck under an awning until it is gone.

stories.name: Sphinx's Revelation
stories.title: The sphinx's lesson
stories.text: A sphinx on the roof of the Jelenn Column speaks to anyone who will listen. Let absolute law inspire a life of absolute order, it says. Those who listen long enough are given a revelation.

outcome.text: The revelation comes at dusk, and you keep it.
The sphinx asks what is heavier than a law.

huge_success.text: You answer well, and the sphinx gives you the revelation and its blessing.

success.text: You answer well enough, and the sphinx gives you the revelation.

failure.text: You answer badly, and the sphinx looks away.

huge_failure.text: You answer badly, and its stare leaves you shaking.

outcome.text: You climb back down to the street.

stories.name: Supreme Verdict
stories.title: An eviction by edict
stories.text: A whole block is being cleared by order of the Senate. Leonos left skyrunes warning of it, though it was cloudy that day. The last tenants are being carried out.

outcome.text: You save what you can, and a clerk gives you a copy of the edict.
Your reading carries the edict's weight, and the clerk lets you keep it.
You leave as the walls come down.

stories.name: Azor's Elocutors
stories.intro: A pair of elocutors are speaking on and on in a hearing room, and no one can stop them. When they finish, the hearing will be won. They turn their voices on you.
stories.win: The elocutors pause, at last, and agree to speak for you. They are yours now.
stories.lose: Their voices fill your head until you cannot think.
stories.flee: You leave them speaking to an empty room.

stories.name: Judge's Familiar
stories.intro: A small owl sits on the rail of the judge's bench and watches you. It misses nothing, says a scribe, and has no sense of humour. It decides you are suspicious.
stories.win: The owl hops onto your shoulder and stays. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It pecks the spell from your hand.
stories.flee: You leave before it decides anything else.

stories.name: Hallowed Fountain
stories.text: A fountain in a square of white stone, where you may rest if you hold the proper permit. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.
